title.en: Unit 1203 Ep.5 — Day 9: The Freezer Secret

beats.en: Day nine of the blackout. Two cans left.
The freezer, opened for the first time since day one,
had thawed long ago.

beats.ko: 지난 화 여러분의 선택은 B, 얼린 생수와 아이스박스!
beats.en: Last time, you voted B: frozen bottles and a cooler!

tts.ko: 지난 화 여러분의 선택은 비, 얼린 생수와 아이스박스!
tts.en: Last time, you voted B, frozen bottles and a cooler!

beats.prompt: Minsu (red hoodie, big round glasses, no hat) stands in a dim blue night kitchen in front of the open freezer that is dripping meltwater onto the floor, holding an open, completely empty blue cooler and looking inside it, confused, one sweat drop. Same simple thick black doodle style as the reference, flat colors, no shading, vertical composition, no text, no letters, no watermark

beats.ko: 그런데 민수 집엔 얼린 생수가 없었죠.
beats.en: But Minsu had no frozen bottles.
Soft chicken.
Sniff, sniff. Smells fine? Let's cook it!
beats.prompt: Close-up of Minsu (red hoodie, big round glasses, no hat) holding a soft pink raw chicken pack right under his nose and sniffing it, eyebrows raised, hopeful smile, small stink lines coming off the pack, dim blue night kitchen background. Same simple thick black doodle style as the reference, flat colors, no shading, vertical composition, no text, no letters, no watermark

beats.en: Grandma clicked her tongue.

tts.en: Grandma clicked her tongue and said,

beats.ko: "녹고 있는 게 아니라 녹은 지 일주일이야. 냉동실은 이틀이면 끝."
beats.en: "It isn't melting. It melted a week ago. A freezer lasts two days."

tts.ko: 녹고 있는 게 아니라 녹은 지 일주일이야. 냉동실은 이틀이면 끝.
tts.en: it isn't melting, it melted a week ago. A freezer lasts two days.

beats.ko: "냄새 멀쩡해도 버려. 탈 나는 균은 냄새가 안 나."
beats.en: "Even if it smells fine, toss it. The germs that make you sick have no smell."

tts.ko: 냄새 멀쩡해도 버려. 탈 나는 균은 냄새가 안 나.
tts.en: Even if it smells fine, toss it. The germs that make you sick have no smell.

beats.ko: "나는 첫날 얼린 생수랑 고기를 아이스박스로 옮겨 이틀 더 먹었어."
beats.en: "On day one I moved my frozen bottles and meat into a cooler. Two more days of food."

tts.ko: 나는 첫날 얼린 생수랑 고기를 아이스박스로 옮겨 이틀 더 먹었어.
tts.en: On day one I moved my frozen bottles and meat into a cooler. Two more days of food.

beats.prompt: The grandma neighbor (gray hair bun, half-moon glasses, mustard yellow cardigan, cane leaning on the counter) alone in her own bright daytime kitchen, lifting frozen water bottles and a pack of meat out of an open freezer into a blue cooler on the floor, calm and efficient, warm daylight from the window. Same simple thick black doodle style as the reference, flat colors, no shading, vertical composition, no text, no letters, no watermark

beats.ko: "평소에 빈칸은 얼린 생수로 채워. 꽉 차면 이틀, 반이면 하루야."
beats.en: "Fill the empty space with frozen water bottles. Full freezer: two days. Half full: one."

tts.ko: 평소에 빈칸은 얼린 생수로 채워. 꽉 차면 이틀, 반이면 하루야.
tts.en: Fill the empty space with frozen water bottles. Full freezer, two days. Half full, one.

beats.prompt: Open freezer interior seen straight on, completely packed: food containers and bags on the shelves with frozen plastic water bottles stuffed into every empty gap between them, frost on the edges, no people. Same simple thick black doodle style as the reference, flat colors, no shading, vertical composition, no text, no letters, no watermark

beats.ko: 민수는 배운 대로 봉투 두 겹, 꽉 묶어 뚜껑 통에.
beats.en: Minsu did it the way he learned: two bags, tied tight, lidded bin.

key.en: EP.4 SKILL: TWO BAGS, TIE TIGHT

beats.en: Grandma nodded for the first time.

beats.en: Minsu's day nine survival score:
seventy-two out of a hundred.

beats.en: His phone has been off since day three, switched on once at noon. Still, seven percent.

beats.ko: 오늘은 재난문자. 전기 복구, 일정 미정.
beats.en: Today: an emergency alert. Power restoration, no date.
